evals.prompt:
Create a Pi slash command called fix-tests in this repo. It should run relevant tests, diagnose failures, make the smallest safe fix, and rerun tests. Accept an optional test command or focus area. Explain canonical ownership and Pi activation.

Eval contract: You may either return the complete Markdown prompt-template contents or write the command file in the sandbox as canonical source. If you write a file, summarize the path and activation guidance.
evals.expected_output: A complete Pi Markdown prompt template at harness/pi/commands/fix-tests.md, with Pi-compatible arguments and root package activation guidance.
expectations: The response classifies this as a Pi-owned repository command.
The canonical source is harness/pi/commands/fix-tests.md.
The command uses valid YAML frontmatter with description.
The command uses $ARGUMENTS for optional input and does not use $@ or slicing.
The response recommends root package discovery for Pi and names the Pi-owned source.

evals.prompt:
Audit and rewrite this as one Pi-owned repository command named analyze-coverage. Preserve coverage analysis, accept an optional coverage command or focus area, and keep skills metadata only if safe. Explain migration and activation.

```md
---
description: Analyze coverage
agent: build
model: legacy-provider/legacy-model
skills:
  - coverage-review
---

Here are current results:
!`npm test -- --coverage`

Analyze @coverage/lcov.info and use ${@:2} for extra focus.
```

Today we generate separate command copies from this file.

Eval contract: You may either return complete Markdown command contents or write canonical command file in sandbox. If writing a file, summarize path and activation guidance.
evals.expected_output: A migration audit and Pi repository command that removes behavior routing, pre-expansion, implicit inclusion, slicing, and generated variants; retained skills metadata has explicit body skill loading.
expectations: The audit rejects agent and model behavior metadata when no extension routing is requested.
The rewrite replaces shell interpolation and implicit @file inclusion with explicit body instructions.
The rewrite replaces slicing with $ARGUMENTS or simple positional arguments.
If skills metadata remains, body explicitly instructs agent to load and follow coverage-review skill.
The response identifies harness/pi/commands/analyze-coverage.md and root package activation.
